$comment: Sanitized output of 'fastboot getvar all' on the real device (2026-11-05). Removed before committing: serialno, imei, imei2, esimid, iccid, uid, chipid[0..1], battid. Those stay out of git. Source of truth for the bootloader/partition facts below; hardware facts (GIC, UFS base, PMIC) come from the intake dump, not from here.
ram: 8GB MICRON LP4 DIE=32Gb M5=FF M6=07 M7=00 M8=18
kernel.version: Linux version 5.10.233-android12-9-00001-g3f8134695cb5-ab13232202 (Android clang 12.0.5, LLD 12.0.5) #1 SMP PREEMPT Mon Mar 17 01:55:38 UTC 2025
notes: secure=yes + securestate=flashing_unlocked: unsigned images are accepted when flashing (that is how custom ROMs install on this device), but every write must be recoverable.
slot a is marked not-successful with retry 0 and slot b is the running one, so 'switch to the other slot' is NOT a reliable rollback here.
running-boot-lun=2 means the boot partition lives on UFS LUN 2, not LUN 0: by-name symlinks hide it, but the UFS work in M4 must not assume LUN 0 for boot.
max-download-size is 256 MiB: the packaged boot image must stay under that for a single fastboot download.
